name: Android16 未Root DirtyFrag 临时提权后能力验证（独立候选）
summary: 公开情报找到 Android16/Linux6.6 vivo iPA2575 的第三方 DirtyFrag v1.10 临时root报告；本环境无受控未root设备/KVM/SDK，未执行漏洞、未获取root或验证WBD。DirtyFrag链需临时SELinux Permissive，须与既有实验边界隔离。
owner: Android DirtyFrag 独立实验（仅用户授权的隔离设备）

defaults.planned_operation: 仅已授权隔离设备；默认只读；需先解决SELinux Permissive授权冲突
defaults.planned_runtime: No device, no KVM, no adb, no emulator or Android SDK in current environment

verification.platform: Android16/Linux6.6 vivo iPA2575 externally reported DirtyFrag v1.10
verification.scope: Third-party success report only; no own device, exploit, root or product tests

limitations: Android 16 OS release not interchangeable with android16-6.12 KMI name; exact firmware and patch required.
No authorized unrooted test target and no local KVM/adb/emulator/SDK; cannot claim exploit or cleanup.
DirtyFrag chain transiently sets SELinux Permissive, conflicting with preceding no-disable scope.
Previous AOSP adb-root and true KSU-preloaded emulator PASS do not show DirtyFrag root success.
Raw physical underlay, tether offload, hotspot/USB, CLAT, battery and vendor/ARM64 differences unverified.
